nja

njar is an R port of the NJA python package for fitting graphs to images of spatial networks.

Installation

You can install the development version of njar like so:

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("fwimp/njar")

Python dependency - scikit-image

In order to provide an option for skeletonization njar can call the python library scikit-image.

For most people this should work as-is (given reticulate - the package used to call python under-the-hood - is very mature).

If you do not (or cannot) run a python environment for any reason, or if this does not work for some reason, you can perform the skeletonization process externally using something like Fiji and then import this image with the following command:

library(njar)
img <- import_image("path/to/image.png", skeletonize = FALSE)
